items.title: Send back the wildlife damage certificate and claim questionnaire
items.action: Get the wildlife damage certificate (Wildschadenbescheinigung) from the hunting lease holder (Jagdpächter) or the police, fill in the enclosed claim questionnaire (Schadenfragebogen), and return both to the insurer.
items.consequence: The partial comprehensive insurance (Teilkasko) claim for the deer collision cannot be processed without these documents.

data.summary: Kfz-Versicherung Beispielsicher AG requests documentation for the deer collision (Wildunfall) on 9 November 2026 involving Bastian Musterquell's vehicle MQ-BQ 207 (claim no. KS-26-1109-218). They need a wildlife damage certificate and the completed claim questionnaire returned within 13 working days of the letter's date (21 November 2026) to process the comprehensive insurance (Teilkasko) claim.
data.explanation: Your car insurer needs proof that the accident was caused by wildlife (a certificate from the hunting lease holder or police) plus the filled-in claim form to pay out under your partial comprehensive cover (Teilkasko). Get the wildlife certificate as soon as possible, complete the questionnaire, and send both back by the deadline shown by the app. If you miss it, your claim may be delayed or your insurer may ask for further proof, so contact them if you need more time.
